content.title: Over 9M pounds of popular Trader Joe’s product recalled
content.text: NEW YORK (PIX11) — More food items have been added to a nationwide recall that involves millions of pounds of food sold nationwide in stores, including Trader Joe’s. Ajinomoto Foods North America Inc. is recalling around 9,885,240 pounds of Trader Joe’s Vegetable Fried Rice due to the presence of foreign objects. The recall notice stated that the recall was issued due to glass varying in size, from 1 to 3 cm long and 2 to 4 mm wide. The recalled products have the following best-by dates: 2/28/2026, 3/3/2026, 3/4/2026, 3/8/2026, 3/10/2026, 3/17/2026, 3/18/2026, 3/20/2026, 3/22/2026, 3/25/2026, 3/31/2026, 4/1/2026, 4/2/2026, 4/9/2026, 4/10/2026, 4/11/2026, 4/12/2026, 4/23/2026, 4/24/2026, 4/28/2026, 4/29/2026, 4/30/2026, 5/3/2026, 5/8/2026, 5/12/2026, 5/13/2026, 5/14/2026, 5/16/2026, 5/21/2026, 5/22/2026, 5/27/2026, 5/28/2026, 5/29/2026, 5/31/2026, 6/4/2026, 6/14/2026, 6/19/2026, 6/20/2026, 6/26/2026, 6/27/2026, 7/7/2026, 7/10/2026, 7/11/2026, 7/14/2026, 7/21/2026, 7/26/2026, 7/28/2026, 7/30/2026, 7/31/2026, 8/7/2026, 8/8/2026, 8/11/2026, 8/12/2026, 8/18/2026, 8/19/2026, 8/20/2026, 8/21/2026, 8/25/2026, 8/26/2026, 9/2/2026, 9/3/2026, 9/10/2026, 9/11/2026, 9/15/2026, 9/16/2026, 9/17/2026, 9/24/2026, 9/25/2026, 9/29/2026, 10/2/2026, 10/6/2026, 10/7/2026, 10/13/2026, 10/14/2026, 10/18/2026, 10/22/2026, 10/23/2026, 10/25/2026, 10/27/2026, 11/5/2026, 11/6/2026, 11/8/2026, 11/19/2026. The nationwide recall already included Trader Joe’s Chicken Fried Rice with stir-fried rice, vegetables, seasoned dark chicken meat, and eggs, and Trader Joe’s Chicken Shu Mai. The products have best buy dates between March 5, 2026, and Oct. 23, 2026. Click here to see the full list of recalled products. Recalled products should be thrown away or returned to the place of purchase. Ben Mitchell is a digital content producer from Vermont who has covered both local and international news since 2021.
